_readme: Real SCG photos imported from the old site (npm run old-photos; see scripts/fetch-old-photos.mjs). 'source' is the old site's file name; the optimized copy is assets/photos/<id>.jpg (max 1600px wide, about 250KB or less). 'alt' describes what is visible; 'caption' is the short lightbox caption. 'pages' lists where the photo is used. Group, event and activity photos only: individual portraits are never imported here.
